senses.gloss: कृच्छ्र (I) a. (f. च्छ्रा) 1. Causing trouble, painful; 2. bad, miserable, wicked; 3. being in a painful situation.

कृच्छ्र (II) m.n. 1. Difficulty, trouble, hardship, calamity, danger, कृच्छ्रं महत्तीर्णः R.xiv.6, M.vi.78; 2. bodily mortification, penance, expation, M.iv.222, xi.191.(कृच्छ्रम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘miserably,’ ‘painfully,’ ‘with difficulty.’)
कृच्छ्र (I) a. (f. च्छ्रा) 1. Causing trouble, painful; 2. bad, miserable, wicked; 3. being in a painful situation.
कृच्छ्र-प्राण a. 1. one whose life is in danger; 2. breathing with difficulty; 3. hardly supporting life.
कृच्छ्र-साध्य a. 1. curable with difficulty (as a disease); 2. accomplished with difficulty.
